cards.title: Take-aways from the Boardroom Summit
items: Write each slide heading as the point, use big text and visuals, and keep one consistent theme set in the Slide Master.
Presenter View shows your notes, next slide and timer; Alt + F5 starts it. F5 starts from slide 1, Shift + F5 from the current slide.
During the show: B for black screen, W for white, a number + Enter to jump, Esc to end.
Share one cloud copy with a link set to the right people and permission; use Version History instead of 'final-v4' files.
Use To for action, Cc for information and Bcc to protect a group's addresses; use Reply All only when everyone needs it.
Never send an angry e-mail at night; save a draft and send a short, polite version the next day.

cards.prompt: Think of your next presentation or important e-mail. Which one habit from this stage, such as Presenter View, a shared link or Bcc, will you use, and what problem will it prevent?

quiz.question: Which key starts a PowerPoint slide show in Presenter View in recent Windows versions?
options: Ctrl + F5
Alt + F5
Shift + F5
F6
quiz.explanation: Alt + F5 starts the presentation in Presenter View. Shift + F5 starts from the current slide.

quiz.question: During a slide show, what does pressing B do?
options: Jumps back to the first slide
Shows a black screen until you press it again
Makes the current text bold
Opens the speaker notes for editing during the show
quiz.explanation: B (or the full stop key) blacks out the screen so attention moves to you. W (or comma) shows a white screen.

quiz.question: Where should Ayesha change the font and colours so every slide in her presentation updates at once?
options: On each slide, using the Home tab
In File > Options > Language
In the Slide Master (View > Slide Master)
In the Notes pane under the first slide
quiz.explanation: The Slide Master controls the layouts and theme for all slides, so one change updates every slide that uses it.

quiz.question: What does the audience see when Presenter View is used with a projector?
options: The slide, the notes and the timer
The next slide and the notes only
The full PowerPoint editing window with the Ribbon
Only the current slide, full screen
quiz.explanation: The notes, timer and next-slide preview appear only on the presenter's screen.

quiz.question: Bilal's team keeps e-mailing new copies of a budget file. What is the best fix?
options: Ask everyone to add 'final' to the file name
Send it as a PDF so nobody can change it
Compress the file into a .zip before each send
Store one copy in OneDrive or SharePoint and share a link
quiz.explanation: One shared copy lets people co-author, and Version History keeps older versions. Names like 'final-v4' do not stop confusion.

quiz.question: A teammate deleted an important sheet from a shared Excel file in OneDrive yesterday. What can Bilal try first?
options: Open Version History and restore or copy from an earlier version
Press Ctrl + Z, because undo history lasts for days
Ask everyone in the team to e-mail their old attachments back to him
Nothing; changes in shared files cannot be reversed
quiz.explanation: Files in OneDrive and SharePoint keep earlier versions. Undo only works for recent actions in the current session.

quiz.question: What is Bcc best used for?
options: Sending to many people without showing their addresses to each other
Sending a copy to your manager that every other recipient can also see
Marking a message as urgent and high priority
Asking recipients to confirm they read the message
quiz.explanation: Bcc recipients are hidden from the others. Cc recipients are visible to everyone.

quiz.question: In Outlook for Windows, which shortcut replies to everyone on a message?
options: Ctrl + Shift + R
Ctrl + R
Ctrl + Alt + R
Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R
quiz.explanation: Ctrl + R replies to the sender only; Ctrl + Shift + R replies to all.

quiz.question: Which subject line is the most professional and useful?
options: Hi
URGENT!!! PLEASE READ
Budget v2 for review by Thursday 4 Dec
Re: Re: Fwd: Re: Fwd: Re: the file you asked for
quiz.explanation: A good subject says what the message is about and any deadline, so the reader can act and find it later.

quiz.question: Bilal shared a staff salary sheet with a link that anyone can open, by mistake. What should he do first?
options: Rename the file so nobody can find it
Delete his sent e-mail containing the link
Use Manage Access to stop or limit sharing, then tell his manager
Wait a few days and check whether anyone outside the company opens the link
quiz.explanation: Changing or removing the link's access stops new people opening it. Report the mistake so the organisation can check who saw it.

bank.question: Bilal wants to move a file from Downloads into his Job Search folder without leaving a copy behind. Which pair of shortcuts does this?
options: Ctrl + X in Downloads, then Ctrl + V in Job Search
Ctrl + C in Downloads, then Ctrl + V in Job Search
Ctrl + Z in Downloads, then Ctrl + Y in Job Search
Ctrl + A in Downloads, then Ctrl + S in Job Search
bank.explanation: Cut and paste moves the file. Copy and paste leaves the original in Downloads.

bank.question: Which file name is NOT allowed by Windows?
options: Invoice-Rashid-2026-11.xlsx
Invoice: Rashid?.xlsx
Invoice_Rashid_Nov.xlsx
Invoice Rashid 2026.xlsx
bank.explanation: Windows does not allow the characters \ / : * ? " < > | in file names, so the colon and question mark make it invalid.

bank.question: Ayesha used Shift + Delete on a file on her laptop and now needs it back. What is true?
options: It is in the Recycle Bin and can be restored with a single click on Restore
It moved to the Downloads folder and can be opened there
It was saved to OneDrive automatically before deletion
It skipped the Recycle Bin, so she cannot simply restore it from there
bank.explanation: Shift + Delete deletes without using the Recycle Bin. A backup such as OneDrive or File History may be her only option.

bank.question: A message says: 'Your parcel is held. Pay Rs 150 customs fee at this link within 2 hours.' Which sign most clearly suggests a scam?
options: The urgent deadline combined with a payment link in a message
The amount is small and sounds reasonable for a customs charge on a parcel
It mentions a parcel, and she is expecting one
It was sent in English rather than Urdu
bank.explanation: Scams use urgency and links to collect payment or card details. Check through the courier's official website or app instead.

bank.question: Why does two-step verification protect an e-mail account even if the password leaks?
options: It changes your password automatically every two days without telling anyone
A second check, such as a code on your phone, is also needed to sign in
It hides your e-mail address from strangers
It blocks every login from a new device for ever
bank.explanation: With two-step verification, a stolen password alone is not enough. Never share the second-step code with anyone.

bank.question: Bilal is leaving his office desk for lunch. Which shortcut locks his Windows computer?
options: Windows key + D
Ctrl + L
Windows key + L
Ctrl + Alt + Tab
bank.explanation: Windows key + L locks the computer. Windows key + D only shows the desktop, leaving everything open.

bank.question: In File Explorer, which shortcut creates a new folder in the current location?
options: Ctrl + Shift + N
Ctrl + N
Ctrl + Shift + F
Ctrl + Alt + Shift + N
bank.explanation: Ctrl + Shift + N creates a new folder in File Explorer. Ctrl + N opens a new File Explorer window.

bank.question: In Word, Ayesha presses Ctrl + J on a paragraph. What happens?
options: The paragraph jumps to the next page
The selected text becomes italic
A table with two columns and two rows is inserted at the cursor position
The paragraph is justified, lined up on both left and right edges
bank.explanation: Ctrl + J justifies text. Ctrl + I is italic and Ctrl + Enter is a page break.

bank.question: Ayesha's CV has the date on the right, pushed there with 30 spaces. What is the most reliable fix?
options: Add more spaces so the date reaches the margin
Make the font smaller so everything fits on one line
Remove the spaces and use a right-aligned tab stop or a borderless table
Press Enter before the date so it sits on its own line and then add even more spaces
bank.explanation: Tab stops and tables hold positions exactly. Spaces move every time text or font changes.

bank.question: Which item should usually be left off a fresh graduate's CV in Pakistan?
options: A professional e-mail address
CNIC number and bank account details
University, degree and year
One measurable result from an internship
bank.explanation: Sensitive identity and bank details are not needed to shortlist you and could be misused if the CV is shared widely.

bank.question: Which part of a formal letter should come directly after the recipient's name and address?
options: The closing, such as 'Yours sincerely'
The subject line, such as 'Application for Trainee Tester'
Your signature and full name
The body paragraph explaining all your skills and your experience in detail
bank.explanation: A typical order is your details, date, recipient, subject line, greeting, body, closing and name.

bank.question: Ayesha typed 'from' as 'form' throughout her letter. Why might F7 not catch it?
options: F7 only checks the first page of a document
F7 checks grammar but never spelling
'Form' is a real word, so a spell checker may accept it
F7 works only after the file has been saved as a PDF
bank.explanation: Spell checkers look for unknown words. Real words in the wrong place often slip through, so read your work yourself.

bank.question: Which shortcut opens the Save As dialog directly in Word?
options: Ctrl + S on a file already saved
F2
Ctrl + Shift + S
bank.explanation: F12 opens Save As in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ctrl + S on a saved file simply saves it again.

bank.question: Ayesha's letter starts 'Dear Sir or Madam'. Her friend says to close with 'Yours sincerely'. What is the traditional formal British-style pairing?
options: 'Yours sincerely', because the reader is not named
'Best regards', because it suits every formal letter
'Yours faithfully', because the reader is not named
No closing at all, because the name is unknown
bank.explanation: Traditionally, 'Dear Sir or Madam' pairs with 'Yours faithfully' and a named reader with 'Yours sincerely'.

bank.question: Cells B2:B5 contain 40, 60, 80 and an empty cell B5. What does =AVERAGE(B2:B5) return?
bank.explanation: AVERAGE ignores empty cells, so it adds 40 + 60 + 80 = 180 and divides by 3, giving 60.

bank.question: Cells A2:A6 hold 5, 'n/a', 10, 15 and an empty cell. What does =COUNT(A2:A6) return?
bank.explanation: COUNT counts only cells with numbers: 5, 10 and 15. Text and empty cells are not counted.

bank.question: Rashid presses Alt + F1 after selecting his data. What does Excel do?
options: Opens the help pane for charts
Inserts a default chart on the same sheet
Creates a chart on a new chart sheet
Adds a SUM formula below the selected data
bank.explanation: Alt + F1 creates an embedded chart of the default type. F11 creates a chart on its own new sheet. Alt + = inserts AutoSum.

bank.question: Which chart is the poorest choice to compare sales across 12 months?
options: A column chart with 12 bars
A line chart with 12 points
A bar chart with 12 bars
A pie chart with 12 slices
bank.explanation: Pie charts show parts of one whole and become hard to read with many slices. Changes over time suit lines or columns.

bank.question: In Excel, which key edits the active cell's contents without deleting them?
options: F4
F7
F9
F2
bank.explanation: F2 enters edit mode in the active cell. F4 repeats an action or toggles $ signs while editing a formula.

bank.question: Rashid's supplier presentation has 5 slides. Which slide breaks the one-idea-per-slide guideline most?
options: A title slide with his name and the date
A slide with a 40-number table and six bullet points
A chart titled 'Floral designs sold out first'
A next-steps slide with three short actions
bank.explanation: A dense table plus many bullets asks the audience to read instead of listen. Show one chart and say the details.

bank.question: In PowerPoint, Ctrl + D with a slide selected in the thumbnail pane does what?
options: Deletes the slide
Opens the Design tab
Starts the slide show
Duplicates the slide
bank.explanation: Ctrl + D duplicates the selected slide or object. Delete removes it, and F5 starts the show.

bank.question: Bilal's report headings were made bold and size 16 by hand, not with styles. What will NOT work well?
options: Printing the report on A4 paper
An automatic table of contents built from the headings
Counting the words in the document
Adding page numbers in the footer of every page of the report
bank.explanation: Automatic contents and the Navigation Pane use heading styles. Manually formatted text looks like a heading but Word does not treat it as one.

bank.question: Which shortcut applies the Heading 2 style in Word for Windows?
options: Ctrl + Alt + 2
Ctrl + 2
Alt + Shift + 2
Ctrl + Shift + 2
bank.explanation: Ctrl + Alt + 1, 2 and 3 apply Heading 1, 2 and 3. Ctrl + 2 sets double line spacing in Word.

bank.question: During a mail merge preview, some letters say 'Dear ,' with no name. What is the most likely cause?
options: Some rows in the Excel list have an empty FirstName cell
The letter was not saved before merging
Track Changes was switched on during the merge
The Word document has too many pages for the merge to finish
bank.explanation: Merge fields show whatever is in the list. Fill in missing names, or filter those rows out, before finishing the merge.

bank.question: Bilal's mail merge list has headings in row 3 because rows 1 and 2 hold a company title. What problem is likely?
options: Word reads row 1 as the field names, so fields will be wrong
Word will skip the first two letters but merge the rest perfectly
Word cannot open any Excel file that contains a title
The merge will print every letter twice
bank.explanation: Word expects the headings in the first row of the selected sheet or range. Remove the title rows or use a clean sheet.

bank.question: Which statement about Track Changes is correct?
options: Accept deletes the edit; Reject keeps it as normal text
Both Accept and Reject leave the edit marked in red in the document
Accept and Reject only work after the file is saved as a PDF document
Accept makes an edit part of the normal text; Reject restores the original
bank.explanation: Accept keeps the change; Reject removes it. Either way, the tracking mark disappears for that change.

bank.question: A Word table of 200 rows runs over several pages. Bilal wants the header row on each page. Which is best?
options: Copy the header and paste it at the top of each page
Split the table into separate tables, one per page
Select the header row and use Repeat Header Rows
Use the page header to type the column titles
bank.explanation: Repeat Header Rows keeps working when rows are added or removed. Pasted headers end up in the middle of pages after edits.

bank.question: Bilal wants one page of his report in landscape for a wide table while the rest stays portrait. What does he need?
options: A page break, then landscape for that page only
A separate document printed and inserted by hand
Section breaks (Layout > Breaks > Next Page) before and after the page
A smaller font so the whole table fits in portrait without any breaks
bank.explanation: Orientation is set per section. A page break does not start a new section, so landscape would apply to the whole section.

bank.question: B2 is 70. What does =IF(B2>=80,"A",IF(B2>=65,"B","C")) return?
options: A
B
C
bank.explanation: 70 is not 80 or more, so Excel checks the inner IF. 70 is 65 or more, so it returns "B".

bank.question: A formula =B2*$E$1 is copied from C2 to C5. What does C5 contain?
bank.explanation: B2 is relative and moves down three rows to B5. $E$1 is absolute and stays the same.

bank.question: Pressing F4 once while the cursor is on the reference F1 in a formula changes it to what?
options: F1:F1
bank.explanation: The first press makes it fully absolute ($F$1). Further presses cycle through F$1, $F1 and F1.

bank.question: The price list has Item Code in column C and Item Name in column A. Rashid wants the name for a code. Why will VLOOKUP struggle?
options: VLOOKUP cannot search text values such as names
VLOOKUP can only return columns to the right of the lookup column
VLOOKUP works only when codes are numbers
VLOOKUP needs the list to be on the same sheet as the formula
bank.explanation: VLOOKUP searches the first column of its range and returns to the right. XLOOKUP (or INDEX with MATCH) can return a column to the left.

bank.question: What does =XLOOKUP(A2,Codes!A:A,Codes!B:B,"Check code") show if A2 is not found?
options: #N/A
Check code
The nearest code's value
bank.explanation: The fourth argument of XLOOKUP is the value to show when there is no match. Without it, XLOOKUP shows #N/A.

bank.question: Which formula adds the amounts in column C only for rows where column B says 'Madina Town'?
options: =COUNTIF(B:B,"Madina Town",C:C)
=SUMIF(B:B,"Madina Town",C:C)
=SUM(B:B,"Madina Town",C:C)
=IF(B:B="Madina Town",SUM(C:C))
bank.explanation: SUMIF(range, criteria, sum_range) adds the sum_range cells whose matching range cell meets the criteria.

bank.question: Rashid's PivotTable shows 'Count of Amount' instead of totals. What should he change?
options: Value Field Settings, choosing Sum instead of Count
Move Amount from Values to Rows
Sort the data by amount first
Turn on conditional formatting for the Amount column
bank.explanation: If some Amount cells are text or blank, Excel may default to Count. Change it in Value Field Settings, and fix any text numbers.

bank.question: A colleague filtered the sales sheet to one branch and says the other rows were deleted. Is that right?
options: No; filtering hides rows, and clearing the filter shows them again
Yes; filtering permanently removes non-matching rows
Yes, but Ctrl + Z within a week will bring them back
No; the hidden rows move to a new sheet called Filter
bank.explanation: Filtered-out rows are only hidden. Clear the filter or press Ctrl + Shift + L to remove the filter arrows and show everything.

bank.question: Ayesha wants her notes on the laptop and only slides on the projector. Which feature does this?
options: Presenter View
Reading View
Slide Sorter View
Outline View
bank.explanation: Presenter View shows notes, the next slide and a timer to the speaker only.

bank.question: During a show, Ayesha needs to jump straight to slide 9. What is quickest?
options: Press Ctrl + 9
Press F9
Press Esc, then click slide 9 and press F5
Type 9 and press Enter
bank.explanation: Typing a slide number and pressing Enter jumps to it during a slide show. Esc then F5 would restart from slide 1.

bank.question: AutoSave is switched on in Word for Bilal's report. What does that usually tell him?
options: The file is saved in OneDrive or SharePoint and changes are saved as he works
The file is saved on a USB stick and backed up daily
Every version is e-mailed to his manager automatically
Nobody else can open the file while he is editing it
bank.explanation: In Microsoft 365, AutoSave works for files stored in OneDrive or SharePoint. Others may co-author at the same time.

bank.question: Bilal needs a colleague to read a confidential report but not change it. Which sharing choice fits best?
options: A link anyone can open, set to edit
A link for that specific person, set to view only
An attachment sent to the whole department
A link posted in the company's public chat group
bank.explanation: Share with only the people who need it and the least permission they need. Options depend on the organisation's settings.

bank.question: Who can see the addresses in the Cc field of an e-mail?
options: Only the sender
Only the people in the To field
Everyone who receives the e-mail
Nobody; Cc addresses are hidden
bank.explanation: Cc addresses are visible to all recipients. Use Bcc to hide addresses.

bank.question: Which e-mail opening follows professional etiquette best for a request?
options: 'HI!!! WE HAVE A BIG PROBLEM WITH THE SCHEDULE'
'Hey, so, um, I was wondering about something, maybe, if possible'
'Dear Mr Kamran, could our pitch slot move to 11:00 on 6 Dec?'
'As per my last e-mail, which you obviously ignored completely...'
bank.explanation: A respectful greeting and the request in the first line help the reader act quickly. Capitals and sarcasm sound like shouting or blame.

bank.question: In Outlook, Bilal presses Ctrl + R on a message sent to 30 people. Who receives his reply?
options: All 30 people on the message
Only the people in the Cc field
Nobody until he adds names
Only the original sender
bank.explanation: Ctrl + R replies to the sender. Ctrl + Shift + R is Reply All.
